correctness.rationale: The exact geometric bisector-normal and lune-area reductions determine the entire ordinary-cell-area distribution. An independent Gaussian polar integral proves the required angular kernel; the CDF is obtained by a normalized density transform, differentiated and integrated exactly. Exact first and second moments and both endpoint Taylor expansions are given. The candidate checker passed deterministic quadrature and 500000 direct point-sampling trials, supplemented by 125000 observations for geometric lune area; finite tests supplement rather than establish the proof.

originality.rationale: The named distribution is for the ordinary area of a labelled Voronoi cell from exactly three Haar-uniform points on S^2. Full accessible primary studies of finite spherical Voronoi face vectors and asymptotic Euclidean cell measures do not give or imply the full fixed-three-site spherical area law. The cosine-kernel ingredient is a known identity and is excluded from the novelty claim. Index and publication searches disclosed no same-law coverage; significant older full-text gaps are identified rather than represented as verified noncoverage.

value.rationale: The cell area in the smallest nontrivial binomial spherical Voronoi diagram is a natural complete random size invariant, not an arbitrary parameter slice. A closed whole-law CDF gives the nontrivial exact variance and the sharp exponents five and two at opposite support endpoints; it can benchmark stochastic spherical tessellation calculations, while the area law is not obtainable from the deterministic face vector alone.
